description: This file defines the SchedulersJob PHP class, which manages scheduled background jobs in the SuiteCRM system, including job status, execution, error handling, and user/environment context switching.

classes.name: SchedulersJob
classes.description: Represents a scheduled background job, managing its lifecycle, execution, error handling, success, failure, and environment context switching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the SchedulersJob class, setting minimum retry interval from global configuration if available.

methods.name: check_date_relationships_load
methods.description: Converts and loads execute_time into database date format, working around date conversion issues.

methods.name: handleDateFormat
methods.description: Returns a formatted datetime string based on input or current time, considering user preferences.

methods.name: fireUrl
methods.description: Triggers a URL via cURL to run a job asynchronously, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for listing in the UI, including job name and job identifier.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Placeholder for additional list view field filling.

methods.name: failJob
methods.description: Marks the job as failed with an optional message.

methods.name: succeedJob
methods.description: Marks the job as successful with an optional message.

methods.name: onFailureRetry
methods.description: Placeholder for logic to execute on job failure where retries are involved.

methods.name: onFinalFailure
methods.description: Placeholder for logic to execute when job fails for the last time.

methods.name: resolveJob
methods.description: Finalizes job status as success or failure, manages retries, logs, and updates scheduler status.

methods.name: updateSchedulerSuccess
methods.description: Updates the scheduler's last run time upon job success.

methods.name: addMessages
methods.description: Aggregates error and info messages into the job's message property for logging.

methods.name: postponeJob
methods.description: Re-queues the job for later execution, optionally with a delay and message.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes the job record from the database.

methods.name: unexpectedExit
methods.description: Handles unexpected termination, marking job as failed if not properly completed.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Executes the job, supporting target types: function, URL, or class-based jobs, with proper error handling and environment setup.

methods.name: setJobUser
methods.description: Sets the execution environment to a specific user for permission and context management.

methods.name: restoreJobUser
methods.description: Restores the previous user environment after job execution.

methods.name: set_error_handler
methods.description: Sets a custom PHP error handler during job execution.

methods.name: restore_error_handler
methods.description: Restores the previous PHP error handler after job execution.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a job class that implements RunnableSchedulerJob, providing the ability to execute custom job code.
